elements.name: Storage tank
elements.description: A vessel with P&ID, flat SCADA and equipment SVG views sharing one level, threshold, nozzle and port contract.

attributes.name: medium
attributes.description: Stored substance. Sets the liquid colour and propagates to process ports.

attributes.name: heater
attributes.description: Whether a heating coil is installed.

attributes.name: heating
attributes.description: Whether the heating coil is energised.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Process status independent from data quality.

attributes.name: quality
attributes.description: Telemetry quality independent from process status.

attributes.name: view
attributes.description: SVG visual family. Does not change the vessel data or ports.

parts.name: shell
parts.description: Vessel silhouette in every visual family.

elements.name: End-suction centrifugal pump
elements.description: A centrifugal pump with interchangeable P&ID, flat SCADA and equipment SVG views over one data, state and port contract.

attributes.name: running
attributes.description: Whether the pump is commanded to run.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Severity independent from operation and data quality.

attributes.name: quality
attributes.description: Telemetry quality independent from process severity.

attributes.name: view
attributes.description: SVG visual family. Does not change data, states, motions or ports.

parts.name: housing
parts.description: Pump body in every visual family.

parts.name: rotor
parts.description: Operation motion target where the selected view exposes one.

elements.name: Isolation valve
elements.description: A manual or actuated isolation valve with P&ID, flat SCADA and equipment views over one open/closed contract.

elements.name: Control valve
elements.description: A control valve with P&ID, flat SCADA and equipment SVG views sharing travel, actuator, state and live-port contracts.

attributes.name: stuck
attributes.description: Whether actual travel has stopped following command.

attributes.name: view
attributes.description: SVG visual family. Does not change valve data or ports.

parts.name: body
parts.description: Valve body in every visual family.

elements.name: Fan / blower
elements.description: A fan or blower with P&ID, flat SCADA and equipment SVG views sharing speed, flow, state and process ports.

elements.name: Compressor
elements.description: A generic process-gas compressor with three interchangeable SVG visual families.

elements.name: Heat exchanger
elements.description: A two-stream heat exchanger with P&ID, flat SCADA and equipment SVG views over the same four process ports.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Whether heat transfer duty is active.

elements.name: Process instrument
elements.description: A generic ISA-style pressure, temperature, flow or level instrument with three SVG visual families.

elements.name: Programmable controller
elements.description: A modular programmable controller with generated I/O modules, dynamic viewport and semantic level of detail.

attributes.name: running
attributes.description: Whether the controller scan cycle is running.

attributes.name: inputs
attributes.description: Digital input channel count from 0 to 32.

attributes.name: outputs
attributes.description: Digital output channel count from 0 to 32.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Controller severity independent from operation and data quality.

attributes.name: detail
attributes.description: Visual level of detail. Auto uses container queries.

elements.name: Semantic zoom centrifugal pump
elements.description: A symbol-first centrifugal pump that progressively reveals live process, operational, and diagnostic layers.

parts.name: process-layer
parts.description: Process direction and moving flow markers.

elements.name: Semantic zoom control valve
elements.description: A standard control-valve symbol with cumulative process, operational, and diagnostic layers.

elements.name: Semantic zoom process vessel
elements.description: A standard vessel silhouette with cumulative level, operating-state, and diagnostic layers.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Whether the vessel has active inflow or agitation.
